title: WIP tracked in git, excluded from all scanners/CI
objective: Keep repository-root WIP/ as a first-class committed draft corpus while ensuring no local gate, pre-commit hook, or GitHub Actions scanner treats WIP content as production source that can fail CI.
success_criteria: Root .gitignore does not ignore the WIP/ tree; only credential-shaped WIP filenames remain denylisted, with an explicit tracked-corpus policy comment
Conflict-marker git grep in .github/workflows/l9-lint-test.yml pathspec-excludes WIP/** (and sibling scratch trees already excluded elsewhere)

Audit confirms existing WIP exclusions remain present and consistent across .pre-commit-config.yaml, .gitleaks.toml, pyproject.toml (ruff/mypy/pytest), sonar-project.properties, CodeQL config, workflow paths-ignore, resolve_changed_files.sh, and run_pr_security.sh
A WIP-only changed-files resolution yields empty scanner targets (make pr / security path); mixed PRs still lint live code without scanning WIP
No bulk WIP corpus commit is required to land the config change; config PR can merge independently

in: .gitignore — policy comment + keep WIP secret denylist; never add blanket WIP/
Scanner/config audit + gap-fill only if a missing WIP exclude is found during implementation
Optional consistency: add :!**/current_work/** :!**/C_GOV_FILES/** :!**/reports/** to the same conflict-marker pathspec if not already present
out: Bulk git add/commit of untracked WIP trees (README, backlog, quantum_animation_spec_pack_v3, etc.) — separate change after secret scrub
Changing CANONICAL_LAW.md / AGENTS.md / ORG_INVARIANTS.yaml protected doctrine
Unrelated dirty-tree work (distill_queue, hydration, transcript_distiller, TODO.md)

pre_validation.pass_criteria: Majority already exclude WIP; only material gap identified is l9-lint-test conflict-marker git grep missing :!**/WIP/**

disconfirming_questions: If someone adds WIP/ to .gitignore, does that contradict 'to be committed' and silently drop backlog from the SSOT?
If a PR changes ops/scripts and WIP together, does paths-ignore: WIP/** still leave ruff/mypy/conflict-marker scanning WIP?
Could excluding WIP from the conflict-marker scan hide real unresolved merges that were accidentally pasted into WIP and later promoted without re-scan?
assumed_false_ifs: WIP remains non-runtime and is never imported by live CI test entrypoints
Credential denylist under WIP stays; agents do not commit oauth/client_secret JSON
Existing pyproject force-exclude and pre-commit exclude continue to apply when tools receive explicit paths
stress_test.blast_radius: Wrong gitignore blankets the corpus out of git; wrong CI exclude lets draft kernels fail quality gates or, conversely, hides conflict markers until promotion
stress_test.rollback: git revert the config commit; restore prior .gitignore WIP block and prior l9-lint-test pathspec

shared_causes: workflow paths-ignore only covers WIP-only events, not mixed-PR full-tree steps
deletions_or_consolidations: Do not invent a second WIP ignore SSOT; keep excludes co-located in each tool's native config and keep comments pointing at resolve_changed_files / pre-commit sync
